title: 第66章 三键成曲
content_zh:
第66章 三键成曲-《华娱2008：从分手快乐开始》

上一章

存书签

下一章

带着耳麦的导演人傻了。

好好的节目录着，怎么突然需要电子琴？

咱是个访谈节目！！

不过气氛都到这了....

他向台上的主持人比个OK的手势。

鲁玉转头说道：“有。”

话音刚落，台下响起惊讶的欢呼声。

观众，从来都是看热闹不嫌事大。

一般节目组观众由两部分构成，一部分是关系户，另一部分是演员。

没错，这年头录制节目需要群众演员来充当气氛组。

有的人需要哭，有的人需要笑，还有的需要鼓掌，各司其职。

好的群演对节目有促进作用，但不能常用。

有的节目就没逼数。

魏沐上辈子吐槽过几个综艺节目，其中一个就是《我是歌手》

吐槽对象不是节目内容，而是群演观众。

踏马的一个比一个离谱，别人在上面唱歌，他们在下面哭嚎，比死了亲爹都难受。

假的一批。

《鲁玉有约》的观众没这么离谱，他们是发自内心的惊讶。

随便弹几个音节，就能创作出一首曲子，不敢相信。

不一会，电子琴被搬上来。

舞台中央，几个主演全部站起来，陈琨饶有兴致的看着这一幕。

上台之前，他还想着怎么给他递词，没想到这小子顺着杆往上爬。

陈琨比周训还厉害点，他95年考进东方歌舞团，作为独唱演员参与多场演出，成名以后发过三张专辑。

三键成曲吗？

他摇着头不敢相信。

或许有人能做到，但他不相信魏沐可以。

这小子太年轻，还不到25岁。

“先声明，我不是托！！”

鲁玉朝着所有人比划一下，然后看向主角。

“咱们是第一次见面，对吧？”

魏沐犹豫了一下回答：“嗯...对。”

“你别犹豫啊，咱们以前真没见过。”

鲁玉表情夸张，吓得后退了一步，闹得全场大笑。

“这样.....”

她围着电子琴绕了半圈，然后把目光落到几个主演身上。

“你们一个人按一个键，怎么样？”

“好！！”

台下爆发出欢呼声。

观众的意见不能忽视，最后定下孙丽、周训以及陈琨三人。

在开始之前，魏沐坐在电子琴面前随便弹了几下，脑海里回忆着各种旋律。

Chapter 66 Three keys make a song - "China Entertainment 2008: Starting from a happy breakup"

The director with the headset was dumbfounded.

After recording a good program, why do you suddenly need an electronic keyboard?

We are a talk show!!

But that’s where the atmosphere ends…

He gestured OK to the host on stage.

Lu Yu turned around and said, "Yes."

As soon as he finished speaking, there were surprised cheers from the audience.

The audience has always watched the fun without taking it too seriously.

Generally, the audience of a program group consists of two parts, one part is related households and the other part is actors.

Yes, recording shows these days requires extras to act as the atmosphere group.

Some people need to cry, some need to laugh, and some need to applaud, each performing his or her duties.

Good group performances can promote the program, but they cannot be used frequently.

Some programs just don’t count.

Wei Mu complained about several variety shows in his previous life, one of which was "I Am a Singer"

The object of complaint is not the content of the program, but the audience.

Each one of them is more outrageous than the other. Others are singing on top, while they are crying and howling below. It is more uncomfortable than the death of one's own father.

A fake batch.

The audience of "A Date with Lu Yu" was not so outrageous. They were genuinely surprised.

Just play a few syllables and you can create a tune. I can't believe it.

After a while, the electronic keyboard was brought up.

In the center of the stage, all the leading actors stood up, and Chen Kun watched this scene with interest.

Before going on stage, he was still thinking about how to deliver the words to him, but he didn't expect this kid to climb up the pole.

Chen Kun is even better than Zhou Xun. He was admitted to the Oriental Song and Dance Ensemble in 1995 and participated in many performances as a soloist. After becoming famous, he released three albums.

Three keys to make a song?

He shook his head in disbelief.

Maybe someone could do it, but he didn't believe Wei Mu could.

This guy is too young, not yet 25 years old.

"First of all, let me state that I am not a bastard!!"

Lu Yu gestured towards everyone, and then looked at the protagonist.

"This is our first time meeting, right?"

Wei Mu hesitated and replied: "Yeah...yes."

"Don't hesitate, we've never met before."

Lu Yu's expression was exaggerated, and he took a step back in fright, making the whole audience laugh.

"This way..."

She circled half a circle around the electronic keyboard, and then set her sights on the leading actors.

"How about each of you pressing a button?"

"Okay!!"

The audience burst into cheers.

The opinions of the audience could not be ignored, and the three finalists were Sun Li, Zhou Xun and Chen Kun.

Before starting, Wei Mu sat in front of the electronic keyboard and played a few random tunes, recalling various melodies in his mind.
